persona-5-royal: By day you're a transfer student in Tokyo, juggling classes, part-time jobs and friendships. By night you and your friends become the Phantom Thieves, slipping into the twisted inner worlds of corrupt adults to steal their hearts. It's a long, stylish, turn-based RPG with one of the best soundtracks around, and Royal is the expanded version with a whole extra semester.
god-of-war: Kratos leaves Greek myth behind for the Norse wilds, where he sets out with his young son Atreus to scatter his wife's ashes from the highest peak. The axe combat is heavy and satisfying, and the story of a hard father learning to raise his kid gives it real weight. Start here before Ragnarök.
god-of-war-ragnarok: The sequel picks up a few years later as Fimbulwinter grips the world and Ragnarök draws near. It's bigger in every way, with more realms, more ways to fight and a larger cast, but it still comes back to Kratos and Atreus.
the-last-of-us-part-ii-remastered: Five years after the first game, Ellie sets out across a ruined Seattle on a quest for revenge, and the story asks hard questions about what that costs. The tense stealth and scavenging are some of the best in the genre, but it's a heavy, violent story. The PS5 version adds No Return, a replayable survival mode.
uncharted-4-a-thief-s-end: Nathan Drake is pulled out of retirement by the brother he thought was dead, for one last hunt after a legendary pirate treasure. It's a blockbuster adventure of climbing, gunfights and set pieces, with warm, funny characters holding it together.
bloodborne: FromSoftware's gothic nightmare sends you through the plague-ridden city of Yharnam, hunting beasts that get stranger the deeper you go. The combat is fast and rewards aggression rather than hiding behind a shield. It's hard and makes no apologies, but few games feel this rewarding once it clicks, and it's a PlayStation exclusive.
blue-prince: You've inherited a mansion whose rooms rearrange every day, and you pick each new room from a hand of options as you open each door, looking for the rumoured 46th room. It's a puzzle game full of clues, codes and secrets that keeps surprising you long after the credits.
demon-s-souls: A ground-up PS5 remake of the 2009 game that started the Souls series, from the team at Bluepoint. You fight through the cursed kingdom of Boletaria, one dangerous level at a time. It looks stunning and is a gentler way into FromSoftware's style than Bloodborne, though only just.
rayman-legends: A bright, inventive 2D platformer that's easy to pick up and great with up to four players on one couch. The musical levels, where you run and jump in time with the soundtrack, are the highlight.
undertale: A small RPG with a big reputation. You fall into an underground world of monsters, and you can talk your way out of every fight instead of winning it. It's funny, strange and surprisingly moving, and the choices you make change how it all plays out.
